questions.question: How is complex subtraction $z-w$ defined?
questions.explanation: Complex subtraction is defined as $z-w=z+(-w)$ (add the additive inverse of $w$).

questions.question: For $z=a+\mathrm i b$ and $w=c+\mathrm i d$, what is $z-w$?
questions.explanation: $z-w=(a+\mathrm{i}b)-(c+\mathrm{i}d)=(a-c)+\mathrm{i}(b-d)$ (subtract componentwise).
